create_sgd_solver: create an SGD solver for approximate Nash equilibrium with configurable temperature and learning rates
run_sgd_solver_init_vars: run the SGD solver init_vars method to initialize strategy distributions for each player
run_sgd_solver_compute_gradients: run the SGD solver compute_gradients method to compute exploitability gradients from payoff matrices
run_sgd_solver_exploitability: run the SGD solver exploitability method to evaluate exploitability as avg squared norm of projected gradient
run_sgd_gradients_function: run the standalone gradients function to compute exploitability gradient with optional Shannon regularization
